results.correct_value: About 3,000-3,500 ft of gain one way to Home Lake/Constance Pass (not 4,000-5,000 ft)
results.evidence: The Warrior Peak peak page breaks the Upper Dungeness approach into ~600 ft to Camp Handy, ~1,850 ft to Boulder Camp and ~700 ft to Home Lake (~3,150 ft one way). A mapping-service route page for Constance Pass + Home Lake via the Upper Dungeness gives 4,782 ft for the whole 19.6-mile round trip (low point 2,489 ft, high point 5,843 ft), showing the 4,000-5,000 ft figure is a round-trip total, not a one-way approach. Both agree with the row's own waypoints (2,500 to 5,330 ft) and itinerary day 1 (2,800 ft).
